posts.name: Sara Shahzad
posts.cooked:
Continuing the discussion from Looking for an n8n Freelancer / Automation Builder:

Hi, I saw your post looking for an n8n implementation partner. The setup you described fits closely with the kind of automation work I’m currently building — especially lead capture, qualification, AI-powered workflows, API integrations, webhooks, notifications, and CRM/Sheets automation.

I work hands-on in n8n and have built workflows including:

• Lead capture → qualification → Google Sheets/CRM → automatic notifications
• AI-powered enquiry triage that categorizes messages, summarizes them, and generates suggested responses
• Webhook/API-based workflows connecting forms, external services, Gmail, Sheets, and other tools

I’m comfortable working with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, authentication, conditional logic, AI/LLM integrations, and multi-step n8n workflows. I’m also comfortable implementing WhatsApp Business/API workflows where the required provider/API access is available, including lead handling, AI responses, human handoff, follow-ups, and booking logic.

I focus on keeping workflows modular, understandable, testable, and maintainable rather than creating unnecessarily complicated automations.

Availability: 30–40 hours/week
Timezone: PKT (UTC+5), with flexibility for international clients
Pricing: $15–20/hour or fixed-price per project depending on scope
Ongoing work: Yes — I’m specifically interested in building a long-term implementation partnership.

Portfolio: https://sarahshehzad.com

I’d also be happy to start with the small paid test project you mentioned.

If useful, I can share screenshots/workflow diagrams of relevant n8n builds as well.

posts.name: Matt Michels
posts.cooked:
Automation that catches leads, triages them and notifies the right person without failing quietly is the hard part of what you describe, and I’ve built two systems like that.

I’m Matt, a solo developer in Detroit (ET) running Detroit Web Agent. One is a lead triage pipeline. Python fetchers pull job posts from several public boards on a schedule, dedupe and score them, and an LLM drafts a response. Every draft goes through a rule-based validator covering allowlisted claims, banned words and language match. A failed draft gets one retry with the exact failure fed back. A second failure goes to a human-review queue with an email alert, and every action is written to an append-only ledger.

The other is a missed-call text-back line. A Twilio voice webhook rings the owner first. On no-answer, a Supabase edge function verifies the Twilio signature, texts the caller back within seconds, logs the miss to Postgres and pushes the caller into HubSpot.

Most of my production automation runs as Supabase edge functions and Python workers, with n8n for orchestration. I have about 20 hours a week.

I can walk you through either build on a live screen-share, just reply here or DM.

posts.name: Rajdip Dutta
posts.cooked:
Hi Jyotirmoy - answering your seven points in order.

1. n8n experience: self-hosted on my own Linux VPS (Docker), running production automations daily - lead capture, AI triage, reporting pipelines, scheduled agents. Before n8n I built the same things in code (Python/JS), which is why APIs, JSON and webhooks are the part I am fastest at.

2. Workflow example you can import right now: lead-capture form → AI triage + drafted reply → Google Sheets log. JSON and README here: GitHub - Rda99/n8n-workflows: n8n workflow templates - lead capture, AI triage, Sheets logging. Importable, documented, testable. · GitHub - n8n import:workflow and it runs on a stock instance in two minutes.

3. WhatsApp/API/AI: APIs and webhooks are daily work (auth, pagination, retries, defensive JSON parsing). OpenAI/Gemini behind HTTP Request nodes. Honest gap: no production WhatsApp Cloud API deployment yet - I would prove that layer in the paid test on your account (webhook handling, 24-hour windows, template approval, human handoff).

4. Pricing/availability: $75 paid test (fixed), then $150-250 per workflow by scope, $450-700 for a full assistant build. 50% upfront on fixed-price work. About 30 hrs/week.

5. Timezone: IST (UTC+5:30).

6. Ongoing: yes - a long-term implementation partnership where you handle clients and I handle builds is exactly what I am looking for.

7. Proof: the repo above; every delivery ships with trigger, failure paths, test log and a handover README.

Happy to start with your small paid test on whichever client use case comes first. DM with subject “n8n Builder” works too.

- Rajdip Dutta, Kolkata (IST)
